(p. 16)

claim_entries.value: evidence_supports_claim

the balanced performance claim matches the evidence’s reach: a 119-question response benchmark establishes breadth and quality differences, while the 12-person counterbalanced study establishes preferences and interaction limitations without claiming learning or deployment effects.

paper_code_entries.value: knowledge_or_concept_gap — many visualization creators lack formal training and accessible design knowledge (PDF p. 1).

limitations: "First, the absence of demographic and expertise data for the Human respondents in the VisGuides forum makes direct comparisons with the Human experts challenging." (p. 21)
"Also, due to the dynamic nature of the feedback sessions in the second study, we were not able to apply the static evaluation metrics used in the VisGuides." (p. 21)
"We used a fixed version of ChatGPT." (p. 21)
"As a result, responses to the questions in our study can vary among newer LLMs." (p. 21)
boundary_conditions: "However, the human baselines in both studies represent distinct real-world scenarios: receiving feedback from anonymous online platforms or from experienced colleagues in the workplace." (p. 21)
"Inclusion criteria required proficiency in English, experience in data visualization creation, and a willingness to share at least one of their data visualizations." (p. 14)
